notes: Built 2026-10-23 by dev/bench/mock-replay.mjs; no recorded prose, only synthetic keys and arm-relative targets.
Record was made against a different repository, so every recorded path is foreign; targets are chosen from the arm's own layout, not from the recording.

Targets are files that exist, byte-identical, in BOTH arms of the frozen image: docs/adr/ADR-0002, ADR-0003, ADR-0005, docs/guides/law-writing-an-adr.md, docs/guides/law-editing-issue-files.md. Re-check each after a new prep.mjs freeze.

file-5 is read at offset 40 (limit 20), so its target must hold at least 40 lines; a shorter file turns the read into FS_NOT_FOUND and the launcher's 'no tool result failed on a path' assertion fails.

The five recorded edits carry old_string prose from the source repository. No path map can make those literals match an arm file, so those five edit calls replay as FS_EDIT_NOT_FOUND: counted and named under mockReplay.toolResults, never hidden. That is a fidelity limit of a foreign record, not a map defect.
10 of 33 turns are scripted: the converter stops the prefix at the first unmappable call (TodoWrite at source turn 11). The remaining 22 turns are dropped, not remapped.
All 10 pwsh calls in the prefix replay as the converter's withheld-command placeholder, so no recorded shell command runs.
textMode is placeholder because the converter's synthetic key form depends on it; a map built for one mode is refused under the other.
